newsitem.title: USA: AT&T unit to build trans-Atlantic cable system.
newsitem.headline: AT&T unit to build trans-Atlantic cable system.

text.p: AT&T Submarine Systems Inc , a unit of AT&T Corp, has been awarded a contract to build an underseas network to directly connect the U.S., Germany and the U.K.
The company said that Global Telesystems Ltd, owned by a privately-held group of investors based in Toronto, will own the cable system.
Terms of the contract were not disclosed.

In addition to being awarded both project development and construction contracts, AT&T-SSI is responsible for operations, administration and maintenance of the Atlantic Crossing 1 (AC 1) submarine cable system, as well as being its exclusive sales agent.
The cable system, expected to be placed into full service in late 1998, will span more than 14,000 kilometers.
The company said AC 1 is unique because its technology will make it the most powerful cable system with the largest capacity ever developed.
